senses.gloss: m. (v. כְּבַב Pa.) roasted or charred dough, כ׳ דארעא roasted (over coals) in a cavity of the ground, name of a pastry baked in a cavity made in the stove.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 38a:1">Ib. 38ᵃ</cite>. [Ar. s. v. <cite ref="K00656"><he>ככא</he></cite>, reads <cite ref="K00248"><he>כוכא</he></cite>.] [<cite ref="Gittin 68a:13">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="K00248"><he>כּוֹכָא</he></cite>.]
